Figures of record this table is projected from: idle 2.211 uA (worst corner, `sim/tools/power_rollup.py`), floorplan 175789.9 um^2 (`layout/floorplan/reports/area.json`, geometry utilisation 0.6). Rows are projections, not measurements: the committed digital footprint is the routed GDS bounding box and only moves when synthesis and place-and-route are re-run.

Rows and why:

- + storage priced as `dffq_1`: model correction, no RTL change: `cond_mem`/`raw_mem` have no reset in `trng_interface.v`, and synthesis already maps all 128 to `dffq_1`
- + `raw_shift` without reset: RTL candidate (`interface-raw-shift-no-reset.patch`): the register is fully overwritten before it is ever read
- + `raw_bit_count` 5 bits: RTL candidate (same patch): 0..31 needs 5 bits; synthesis had already pruned the unused top bit, so the synthesized saving is zero
- alt: FIFO storage as `latq_1`: NOT adopted: needs latch timing under STA/CTS and a restructured write strobe; changes the sequential style of ratified storage
- alt: `reg_rdata` mux as `mux4_1`: NOT adopted: inventory arithmetic only. The inventory prices reg_rdata as 96 full mux2 although most data bits have constant-zero CTRL/STATUS inputs; synthesis was not run on this variant, so the figure is not credible as a saving

Cumulative candidate set (`+ `raw_bit_count` 5 bits`): projected idle 2.137 uA against `< 1 uA` (still missed); projected floorplan 172739 um^2 against `< 50000 um^2` (still missed).
